semiconductor_relevance: High — Rokko Electronics specializes in wafer processing services critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Rokko Electronics Co., Ltd. provides contract processing services for semiconductor wafers, including grinding, polishing, and cleaning for materials such as silicon, silicon carbide, and sapphire. They focus on achieving ultra-thin and ultra-flat wafers tailored to customer specifications, ensuring high-quality surface finishes for various applications.
capabilities: Wafer grinding and polishing for Si, SiC, and sapphire
Integrated processing services for ultra-thin wafers
Rokko puremium process for enhanced cleaning and surface quality
Special processing needs including grinding-finish and polishing-only services
